positions.name: GateRequirementDeclaration
positions.frame: What is being declared as the deployment gate's binding rule, scope, and ownership?
positions.why: Read together, these four expressions perform one continuous declarative act rather than four separate remarks: src-1 states the requirement in prose ('now requires a signed release manifest'), and src-3/src-4/src-5 restate and extend it in the terse bold-label protocol form (Gate/Scope/Owner) the register pass flagged as a single formal signature spanning exactly this set. Relationally and in power terms all four enact authority-ranking / legitimate-authority moves — a rule imposed by position, not argued for — and conviction reads all four as decision-grade (a settled rule being declared, not a claim under debate). Src-2 sits outside this group: it is the causal justification for the gate (rational-persuasion/informational, claim-level, past-tense), a distinct directional read from the declaration itself, though the two are clearly related in content — that relation is left as tension rather than merged.
